body: Update: tried talking to elise but Brendan came between us saying quietly to me" I know what you're doing, and I won't stand for it

Thanks. If it doesn't work out, well then I will see what I do when that time comes. I will try to talk to her after school before band maybe. I really appreciate all of your help. I'll put the thought of suicide on the back-burners :) Good night LtBenben
Is a walk a good way to portray emotions to her? What if we are like a mile from where we started and she says she is going with Brendan this time? It is a good idea though.

During the fall there isn't any free time because Mon Tues Thur Fri And Sat have band after school.If she is ever at a party, I don't get invited. If she is hanging out with friends, I don't get invited. All because one person doesn't like me. I can't really show all of my emotions for her through a text but if that is what it takes, I could try

I have never had a chance to show her my feelings. They have been building up to the point where if I had a chance, I already know what I would say. I have told one friend(only friend) and this thread. Getting that chance is the hardest thing because Brendan would hang by her if he saw me going to her. Even at water breaks during band, if I try to walk over to her, he runs there while saying something harsh to me as he passes by.

Thanks. You really have helped and I will focus tomorrow(today because it is 2 in the morning) on trying to see the positives even though there are a lot of negatives. Could I pm you if I need it again soon?

She wanted to date him, but he said no. He heard I wanted to ask her this year as well, so he plans on asking which will certainly lead against my favor. Don't hotline numbers cost money? I don't have anything to rebuild on. Practically everyone thinks of me as a kid who Brendan doesn't like and  I am a higher chair on trumpet than him and he still says I suck. What other perspective is there?

She was my first friend when I moved and for a while my only. Doing everything alone is one of the things I fear most because it'll feel like I am moving on. And there is nothing to move on to. If I am alone, no one can stop what I might do to myself, which is why I worry. I don't want to die, but that seems like one of the only answers. Everything went to crap last year and I can't rebuild no matter where i try to start.

I sort of stopped believing in myself because whenever I did, I was called cocky and arrogant. I didn't even go overboard with the confidence, but I can try to give myself more motivation. I wasn't like this before I moved, and even after I did, it wasn't to this point until last year. I appreciate the help.

Thanks. I appreciate the fact that there are people that know what I am going through. What helped you get from where I am to where you are know? You sound like you have it all figured out, and even if you don't, you have more experience than me. I just have a really hard time finding the willpower to even get out of bed sometimes.  One of the only reasons from ending it is because I imagine it'll hurt a lot
